programs.title: Taste the world with Pascal
programs.desc: Another spice grown in Zanzibar is pepper.Amir, a farmer, will guide the camera around his plantation.He will explain how to plant and care for different types of pepper.Pascal will also visit Darajani Market, where you can buy vegetables, fruits and other products typical of this region.The master chef will also go fishing with the local fisherman, Kombo, and then visit the fish market.Local chef Ashi will help Pascal prepare a unique dish.In addition, the host will prepare a Polish-Zanzibar dish, i.e. sweet potato puree with coconut milk and pork tenderloin with colorful pepper.

programs.title: Taste the world with Pascal
programs.desc: During another culinary journey, Pascal Brodnicki learns the secrets of Zanzibar's cuisine.He tastes local delicacies, visits markets and places where local food is produced.

programs.title: Taste the world with Pascal
programs.desc: Master chef Pascal Brodnicki shows viewers how to replace traditional dishes with Asian dishes.It proves that preparing an original dinner is simple and does not have to cost much.In search of culinary inspiration, he goes to Vietnam, Laos and Thailand.He shops at local markets, prepares and sells snacks on the street, and works on a rice plantation.To prove himself, he prepares exotic dishes for his Asian hosts.He tries grilled gecko and baked ant larvae, and accepts an invitation to an unusual hunt.

programs.title: Man, Woman, Wild
programs.desc: In the program, a married couple takes up the challenge and tries to survive in the wilderness.Mykel Hawke is an expert in the US Army Special Forces Survival School, and his wife Ruth is a television journalist.We will meet them in the most remote and dangerous corners of the world, where they will have to survive for four days with only a knife.This is one of the most difficult exams that will test not only their resilience, but also the durability of their marriage in extreme situations.Mykel was taught how to survive in any conditions.However, for Ruth, encounters with wildlife are a completely new experience.A man will have to teach his wife how to build a roof over her head and how to look for food.
